description: Featuring models for every experience level, the Rise Freestyle Scooters deliver a high-quality ride with a stylish look. Whether you want to show off at the skate park or just ride around town, these durable, lightweight scooters can take whatever you throw at them. Perfect for beginner to intermediate level riders, the Rise 110 Expert weighs a mere 9.6 lbs and is loaded with outstanding features, including a one-piece welded 603 x 603 cm steel T-bar handlebar with internal sealed threadless headset, 508 x 115 mm hollow box alloy deck, 110 mm high impact alloy wheels with steel brake, durable ABEC-9 bearings, and triple anodized CNC clamp collar and CNC alloy fork. Epic adventures await with a Rise Freestyle Scooter!
